items.title: Submit certificate of enrolment for winter semester 2026/27
items.quote: Please send us the certificate for the winter semester 2026/27 by 11 January 2027.
items.computation: The letter states a fixed calendar date by which the certificate must reach the insurer: 11 January 2027. Checking the weekday: 2027-01-01 falls on a Friday, so 2027-01-11 (ten days later) falls on a Monday - a normal business day in NW, so no weekend/holiday shift applies. The due date is simply the date printed.

items.quote: If it does not reach us by then, we will switch your policy to the standard rate from February 2027.
